**Finding: compliant** (rule ASSIGN, high severity) — no redline proposed.

Section 24 sits at the **preferred** position on every material term:

- **§ 24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets **without Vendor consent** (prompt notice + assignee assumption only).
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld for a capable, financially sound assignee), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **§ 24.3** — Residual assignments are mutual, reasonable-consent based.
- **§ 24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor **no** right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service, plus a cooperation obligation for successor administration.

Cross-checks: § 13.3 ties licence transfers to permitted Section 24 assignments (consistent, not a back-door restriction), and § 9.2's insolvency termination right expressly excludes lawful reorganizations that do not impair performance, so it cannot be used as a change-of-control exit. No walk-away triggers present.
